summary: Mara returns to Aster Reach by ferry.
Mara and Iven hear an apparent second bell from the cliff.
Mara puts the silver key in the observatory safe and leaves without it.
Mara discovers ledger entries bearing Orin's initials after his disappearance.
Mara enters the customs tunnel carrying the silver key without retrieving it on-page.
Iven admits giving Orin's sketch to Hadrin and delaying contact with Mara.
The shortened bell interval releases retained reflections into town.
A voice behind the lighthouse door answers Orin's private ledger phrase.
Mara pulls the bell once before deciding whether to open the door.
